'''Unakki eye spiders''' were a species of arachnids that caused damage to [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Scabrous]] unleashed a number of unakki eye spiders on his [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] on [[Odacer-Faustin]] around [[3645 BBY]]. The spiders killed two students and attacked at least eleven others, including [[Hartwig]] and [[Soid Einray]]. Although Hartwig survived the incident, he would continue to wake up on a number of mornings with blood in his eyes. Soid Einray [[Death/Legends|hanged himself]] as a result of the damage caused by the spiders.
